assignment: Assessment 1 - Source-to-Bronze Data Profiling and Reconciliation
description: Source schema for the daily transaction extract produced by the Core Banking system, ingested into the Bronze layer as bronze.transaction_daily.

tables.description: Daily transaction extract from the Core Banking source system, approximately 25 million records per day.
tables.enforce_constraints_notes: Raw landing table - profiling is supposed to find duplicate transaction_id, invalid transaction_type, and null critical fields, so this table must not reject them at insert time. See docs/features/04-seed-mock-data.md -> Design -> constraint relaxation for realistic dirty data.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.notes: Primary business key; used to detect duplicates and to join source to Bronze.

columns.name: transaction_amount
columns.notes: Expect positive, non-zero values; flag negative or zero amounts.

columns.name: local_currency_amount
columns.notes: Expected: local_currency_amount = transaction_amount * exchange_rate, within tolerance.

columns.name: ingestion_file
columns.notes: Used to trace late-arriving/missing files during root-cause analysis.

columns.name: source_extract_ts
columns.notes: Some source timestamps are UTC while ingestion uses Singapore business dates; a known root cause of missing records near midnight.
